name: Islamabad
overview: The modern green capital of Pakistan situated at the foot of the Margalla Hills. The primary briefing hub where international climbing teams secure government permits at the Alpine Club of Pakistan before departing for the northern high passes.
transitToNorth: Daily flights to Gilgit and Skardu, or gateway to the Karakoram Highway via Hazara Motorway.

name: Lahore
overview: The cultural heart of Pakistan. Origin point for organized luxury mountain caravans connecting Mughal architectural splendour with the rugged northern Karakoram.
transitToNorth: Direct motorway connection to Islamabad (3.5 hrs) and seasonal chartered flights.

name: Karachi
overview: The massive coastal metropolis on the Arabian Sea. Origin of the 'Sea to Summit' travel concept, connecting sea-level adventurers directly with the 8,000m summits of northern Pakistan via express flights.
transitToNorth: Direct 2-hour daily flights to Islamabad, connecting directly to Gilgit and Skardu mountain aircraft.

name: Peshawar
role: Silk Road Gateway to Hindu Kush
overview: The ancient crossroads of Central and South Asia. Staging ground for high expeditions heading north into the legendary Hindu Kush range, Lowari Tunnel, and the valleys of Chitral.
transitToNorth: Direct transit north through Swat Expressway and Lowari Tunnel to Chitral and Tirich Mir (7,708m).

name: Abbottabad
overview: Nestled in the Orash Valley surrounded by pine-covered hills. A pleasant acclimatization waypoint between Islamabad and the high Karakoram Highway.
transitToNorth: Strategic gateway along the Hazara Motorway leading toward Mansehra and Babusar Pass.

name: Quetta
overview: The high-altitude valley city of Balochistan encircled by dramatic limestone ramparts: Chiltan, Zarghun, and Koh-i-Murdar. Staging ground for arid alpine and canyon adventures.
highlights: Ziarat Juniper Forest (2nd largest on Earth)
transitToNorth: Flight connections to Islamabad or highway links through the Bolan and Lakpass routes.

name: Swat Valley
overview: Renowned for its emerald alpine valleys, gushing Swat River, pine-clad mountains, and ancient Buddhist archaeological heritage.
transitToNorth: Accessible via the modern Swat Motorway from Islamabad in 3.5 hours.

name: Chitral & Kalash Valleys
overview: Guarded by the colossal pyramid of Tirich Mir (7,708m), the highest peak of the Hindu Kush. Home to the indigenous Kalash animist community and the world's highest polo ground at Shandur.
transitToNorth: Accessed through the 10.4km Lowari Tunnel from Dir or via Shandur Pass from Gilgit.

name: Neelum Valley
overview: A 240-kilometer crescent-shaped alpine canyon blanketed in dense silver fir forests, roaring river rapids, and high glacial tarns like Ratti Gali.
transitToNorth: Scenic road access from Muzaffarabad following the Neelum River.

name: Naran & Kaghan Valley
overview: The scenic corridor connecting central Pakistan with Gilgit via Babusar Pass. Famed for the legendary folklore of Saif-ul-Malook Lake and soaring Malika Parbat.
transitToNorth: Direct summer conduit on N-15 highway crossing into Chilas on the Karakoram Highway.

name: Hunza Valley
overview: Ancient mountain kingdom renowned for extraordinary longevity, Rakaposhi views, terraced orchards, and 900-year-old stone fortresses.
transitToNorth: Situated directly on the Karakoram Highway, 2 hours north of Gilgit.

name: Skardu & Baltistan Basin
overview: The dramatic headquarters of Baltistan. Staging launchpad for all expeditions heading into the Baltoro Glacier, Concordia, K2, Broad Peak, and Deosai Plateau.
transitToNorth: Served by Skardu International Airport with daily jet flights from Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi.

name: Chamonix-Mont-Blanc
overview: The historic birthplace of modern mountaineering. Nestled beneath the Mont Blanc massif with world-class cable cars, alpine refuges, and technical granite spires.
transitToNorth: 1 hour 15 minutes by alpine express shuttle from Geneva International Airport.

name: Zermatt & Matterhorn
overview: Car-free mountaineering village dominated by the legendary tooth-like pyramid of the Matterhorn. Premier center for technical rock and mixed climbing.
transitToNorth: Connected via Glacier Express and Swiss Federal Railways.

name: Khumbu Region & Namche Bazaar
overview: The dramatic mountain kingdom leading to Mount Everest. Home to ancient Tibetan Buddhist monasteries, high yak pastures, and the perilous Khumbu Icefall.
transitToNorth: Accessed via high-altitude STOL flight from Kathmandu to Lukla Airport followed by on-foot trail.
